$comment: Paths the template must never change here. See docs/engineering/template-relationship.md and plus-uno-blueprint#105. Enforced by scripts/check-template-quarantine.mjs.
$commentRoots: Two grafted histories, so two root commits, and BOTH are needed to tell them apart. A merged-in parent carries TEMPLATE content when it descends from templateRootCommit and NOT from instanceRootCommit. The template test alone is not enough: since the graft (#105) every commit in this repo descends from the template root, so that test alone also matches our own branches — including the synthetic merge commit GitHub builds for a pull request, which made this guard fail every PR that touched a quarantined path.

quarantine.reason: This instance runs a real Supabase and carries ~800 migrations the package does not. The package ships a dummy backend.
Per-scenario seed SQL for this instance's own blueprint content.
Generated from this instance's content, not the package's META-BLUEPRINT sample.
Project-local Supabase settings — ports, project id, auth config.

This deployment's own source root, whole. Every file the flip kept is here — the DeploymentConfig, the bootstrap that names the storage prefix and registers the reference documents, the cover, the pre-database board, the brand dials, the cross-repo contract with uno-bot. The old list named five paths under `src/` one at a time because the deployment's files were scattered through a copy of the application; they are not scattered any more, and a tree the template has no counterpart for is quarantined as a tree.

notQuarantined.supabase/schema.reference.sql: The package's portable-core contract (agentic-service-blueprinting#51). Generated upstream from its migrations — take its changes.
notQuarantined.supabase/DATABASE.md: Shared schema narrative. Diverges on instance specifics, but upstream improvements are wanted.
notQuarantined.node_modules/agentic-service-blueprintin: Not a subject at all, and named here so nobody adds it. The application arrives as an installed dependency; a template merge cannot touch it, and what it contains is settled by the pin in package.json and by scripts/check-reconciled-files.mjs, not by this guard.

$commentQuarantine: src/data/**, src/config.ts, src/types/database.ts, src/lib/agent/role.md and src/lib/agent/canvas-adapter.md were removed when this deployment stopped keeping a copy of the application. Three of them no longer exist here in any form — config.ts, for one, became DeploymentConfig.brand. Two moved into the deployment root and are covered by deployment/** above: canvas-adapter.md, and types/database.ts, which came back as deployment/types/database.ts once it was clear that the package's copy states the TEMPLATE'S schema and cannot state this one. A pattern that can never match again is worse than no pattern: it reads as protection and is not, and this guard has no staleness check of its own beyond the test that every quarantined path still exists.
